text.tspan: Voter turnout in major Canadian cities
Data source: Elections Canada (2025); "After a low-turnout election with a postal disruption, St. John's eyes election
reform", CBC News (2026); Elections Prince Edward Island (2022); Halifax Regional Municipality (2024); "Shawn Crossman
is Moncton’s new mayor", TJ News (2026); Élections Québec (2025); City of Toronto (2022); City of Winnipeg (2022); "Regina
municipal votes up more than 11,000 from last election for overall turnout of 26%", CBC (2024); Elections Calgary (2025);
CivicInfo BC (2022); City of Whitehorse (2024); City of Yellowknife (2022); Elections Nunavut (2022).
Municipal election data collected as of October 13, 2026. **Federal election voter turnout was calculated as the mean
voter turnout for all federal electoral districts within the municipality.
